terminal.aboutText:
Enzo Morello / Computer Science student at IUT2 Grenoble.
Passionate about web development, video games, and creation.
Application Development track.
jokes: Why do developers hate nature? Too many bugs.
There are 10 kinds of people: those who understand binary and those who don't.
A developer doesn't drink coffee... they execute Java.
How many programmers to change a light bulb? None, it's a hardware problem.
An SQL query walks into a bar, sees two tables, and asks: can I join?
Wi-Fi went down for 5 minutes, I had to talk to my family. They seem nice.
Rule #1 of code: if it works, don't touch it.
My code works and I don't know why. My code doesn't work and I don't know why.

discord.title: Discord Bot
discord.technologiesAria: Technologies used for the Discord bot
discord.intro: is a complete Discord bot developed in JavaScript/Node.js (discord.js v14), combining casino games, social features, and conversational AI. It provides:

features.games: 15+ casino mini-games: blackjack, roulette, slots, craps, high/low, progressive slots, PvP duels, gacha, and even Tetris.
features.economy: Persistent virtual currency with auto-seeding ($10k), server leaderboards, and transaction history.
features.ai: Integrated with OpenRouter (DeepSeek), real-time image analysis, adaptive personality based on user attitude (hostile ↔ friendly).
features.relations: Sentiment tracking, attitude levels (friendly, neutral, annoyed), and per-user conversation memory.
features.infrastructure: Hosted on Railway with Docker, persistent PostgreSQL database with 8 optimized tables.

discord.githubAria: View Discord bot source code on GitHub (opens in new window)
discord.dashboardCaption: Railway dashboard: environment variables, PostgreSQL metrics, and application logs

about.metaDescription: Technical architecture and stack of Enzo Morello portfolio - React, Vite 8, TypeScript, Framer Motion, and custom CSS.

stack.title: Tech stack
stack.intro: Technologies selected for this portfolio - lightweight, modern, and focused.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.intro: TypeScript React SPA with legacy TypeScript modules for music, visual effects, and DOM interactions.

themes.title: Theme system
themes.introPrefix: Five visual moods driven by CSS custom properties on
themes.note: Accent, background, text colors and icon filters adapt automatically using the same CSS variables - no JavaScript needed for rendering.

ambient.title: Effects & ambiance
ambient.intro: Non-blocking decorative layer: effects load in the background and gracefully disable if target DOM is missing.

react.desc: Functional components, hooks, route-based lazy loading and Suspense for code splitting.

vite.desc: Ultra-fast build with HMR, TypeScript aliases, optimized bundling, and PWA integration via vite-plugin-pwa.

router.desc: BrowserRouter with shared Layout via <Outlet />, active NavLinks, and client-side navigation.

framerMotion.desc: SVG path morphing for the mascot robot, enter/exit transitions, and spring effects.

css.desc: 35 isolated CSS modules, centralized custom properties in _variables.css, zero !important, PostCSS + Autoprefixer.

githubPages.desc: Vite build deployed via GitHub Actions (typecheck + build + 404 fallback).

routing.label: Routing
items: All pages are lazy-loaded (route-level code splitting)
pageConfig in Layout.tsx: background, title and meta by route

components.label: Components
items: 43 TypeScript React components in src/components/ (including ambient and pet)
Ambient layer: 18 decorative components in components/ambient/
Component-scoped CSS to avoid cascade pollution

globalState.label: Global state
items: MoodContext - active mood persisted in localStorage
ReadingTimeContext - reading estimate provided to pages
AccessibilityContext - persisted a11y options (contrast, typography, no-motion)

customHooks.label: Custom hooks
items: usePortfolioModules(tracks) - lazy init of legacy modules

legacyScripts.label: Legacy scripts
items: music-player.ts - persistent audio player, ~1 write/s localStorage throttle
effects.ts - particles.js, parallax, and performance-tier adaptation
ui-enhancements.ts - typing, footer clock, video hover, back-to-top
lightbox.ts - gallery zoom with keyboard navigation for .zoomable images

footerDiorama.name: FooterDiorama
footerDiorama.desc: Pool of 10 mini SVG dioramas; 2 or 3 are randomly rendered above the footer on each route change.

ambientEffects.name: AmbientEffects
ambientEffects.desc: Ambient orchestrator driven by mood, accessibility settings, and performance tier (Europa frost, industrial neons, embers, drones, etc.).

pet.name: Robot mascot
pet.desc: Interactive companion: RAF wandering, pointer-capture drag, hunger/happiness stats, achievements, catch mini-game, SVG thought bubbles, and Framer Motion face morphing.

music.name: Music player
music.desc: Persistent playback across routes, auto-discovery of .m4a/.mp3 tracks in /assets/music/, and serialized state (track, position, pause, volume, mute).

privacy.intro: Data is processed only for portfolio operation and contact handling.

usage.contact: Reply to messages sent through the contact form.

usage.measurement: Track traffic in a technical way to improve the site (when analytics is enabled).

recipients.analytics: Depending on configuration: Cloudflare Workers (webhook proxy), Discord Webhook, and approximate geolocation services (geojs.io / freeipapi.com).
